claim_one_line: THE INDEX ON SEVERAL BOUNDARY TORI, DERIVED FROM THE SAME PAIR SEQUENCE AND VERIFIED -- THE BLOCKER THE PAPER'S WALL NAMES IS CLEARED. Section 14 of THE PAPER states that the 54 multi-cusped chiral covers to degree ten are named but cannot be evaluated because the index on several boundary tori must first be derived. It is derived here. B1297's derivation uses exactly five inputs and each is checked for a hidden dependence on one cusp: a_3 = 0, chi(M;V) = 0, Poincare-Lefschetz a_2 = b*_1, the exactness step b*_1 = (t*_0 - a*_0) + n(V*), and the annihilator property r_1 + r*_1 = t_1. The last two are the ones that could have failed and neither does -- the exactness step needs H^0(M;V*) -> H^0(dM;V*) injective, which survives because the map is v to (v,...,v) on c components and M is connected; the annihilator property survives because the pairing on H^1(dM) is the DIRECT SUM of the per-torus pairings and a direct sum of perfect pairings is perfect. SO THE FORMULA IS UNCHANGED: I(V) = (a_0 - a*_0) + t*_0 - r_1, and in domain D, I = t_0 - r_1 = sum_i t_0^(i) - r_1. What changes underneath is not nothing: B^1(dM;V) = (+)_i B^1(T_i;V), each torus carrying its OWN coboundaries so dim B^1 = sum_i (d - t_0^(i)) and not d - t_0 -- the one place a naive extension silently computes the wrong r_1 -- and isotropy becomes a condition on a SUM of per-torus pairings, so it can vanish by CANCELLATION BETWEEN CUSPS, which is impossible with one cusp and is the only structurally new phenomenon. A prediction is derived and TESTED rather than assumed: peripheral holonomy is unipotent, so Sym^m of it has every eigenvalue 1 and multiplying by a primitive cube root leaves none, hence at a cusp where psi is NON-trivial t_0 = t*_0 = 0 and that cusp contributes nothing to t_0, t_1 or r_1 -- the index sees only its LIVE cusps, B1332's mechanism applies at each, and cancellation needs at least TWO live cusps, which is the sector to aim at and is reported per row. VERIFICATION: representations found honestly by enumerating rho into SL2(F_q) and keeping the tuples that kill every relator, then twisted by characters (a self-dual V gives I = 0 by T3 and would test nothing); 132 one-cusped control sectors on m004 and m003, 96 on m129, and 3304 across 30 two-cusped census manifolds, with ZERO identity failures in 3532 sectors, of which 274 are live and 182 have t_0 >= 2. The strongest check is an exact reproduction: run at c = 1 on s958 over Q(zeta_12) the multi-cusp code agrees with B1332's validated one-cusp code sector for sector, all 18 rows identical. TARGETS REPRODUCED INDEPENDENTLY: m004 has 64 multi-cusped covers to degree ten of which 54 are CHIRAL by the orientation-aware symmetry_group().is_amphicheiral() test, matching THE PAPER's count exactly, and 51 of the 54 are recognised EXACTLY over Q(zeta_12) with every relator evaluating to +-I, so the evaluation runs on exact arithmetic on the object's own tower rather than on floating point; the three that resist PSLQ at 60 digits are recorded as unrecognised rather than approximated. A guard reports FAILURE when a run tests no sector, which fired once in development when an empty rep set was cheerfully reported as all identities holding. EVALUATION (addendum, same arc): ALL 54 chiral multi-cusped covers -- the three that first resisted PSLQ were a NORMALISATION artifact, not a field obstruction, since every trace of all three including traces of squares lies in Q(sqrt-3) and only the chosen conjugate was bad, so all 54 are now exact over Q(zeta_12) -- 38070 sectors at three primes with ZERO identity failures, 7739 live and 1841 with TWO OR MORE LIVE CUSPS -- the regime that cannot exist on one cusp and the one place B1332's mechanism stops applying -- and the index is ZERO in every one, the distribution reaching 5 cusps with all 5 live and t_0 = 10; the derived invisibility prediction holds in all 38070 with no exception. Because r_1 is a DIFFERENCE of ranks, each of which can drop mod p, a mod-p zero does NOT force an exact zero, so the richest sectors were redone exactly over Q(zeta_12): the two 5-cusped covers d10_32 and d10_17, 486 exact sectors, 58 with >=2 live cusps including 2 with all five live, zero identity failures, ZERO non-zero. So THE TRIGGER DOES NOT FIRE -- and it is not proved unfireable either: the broad pass is mod p at three primes with 9 cover/prime skips, the exact pass is one germ shape on two covers, and the germ set reaches Sym^4 but not the full range B1330 used on the one-cusped targets. v2873, B1330's mod-p-only one-cusped target, is NOT fixed by the improved recogniser and that caveat stands. A strong negative over a wide but not exhaustive family, recorded as that.
